At AestheticEye, we understand that not every patient requires or desires surgical intervention to achieve their aesthetic goals. Our board-certified oculoplastic surgeons, Dr. Ginger Henson and Dr. Jonathan Pargament, offer a variety of non-surgical treatments designed to enhance your appearance with minimal downtime. Our non-surgical options are tailored to address various cosmetic concerns, providing natural-looking results with less invasive techniques.

Non-Surgical (Minimally Invasive) Facial Rejuvenation

Non-surgical facial rejuvenation treatments offer a quick and effective way to refresh your appearance without the need for surgery. These minimally invasive procedures can address a range of issues, from fine lines and wrinkles to volume loss and skin texture.

Sofwave™

An advanced ultrasound-based treatment designed to stimulate collagen production and improve skin elasticity. This FDA-cleared, non-invasive procedure effectively reduces fine lines, wrinkles, and sagging in key areas with minimal downtime.

UltraClear®

A revolutionary FDA-cleared laser treatment designed to rejuvenate the skin by stimulating collagen production. This non-invasive procedure creates controlled microchannels to improve texture, reduce fine lines, wrinkles, acne scars, and uneven skin tone, with minimal discomfort and downtime for all skin types.

Dark Circle Treatment (Eye Bags)

Targeted treatments for dark circles and eye bags can help reduce pigmentation and puffiness, resulting in a more rested and youthful appearance.

Eyelid Scar Treatments

Non-surgical scar treatments can help minimize the appearance of scars on the eyelids, improving both function and aesthetics.

Non-Surgical Eyelid Lift

A non-surgical eyelid lift can tighten and lift the skin around the eyes using advanced techniques, providing a refreshed look without surgery.

Skin Conditions

We offer treatments for various skin conditions, including rosacea, acne, and hyperpigmentation, helping to improve the overall health and appearance of your skin.

Injectables

Injectables, such as Botox and other neuromodulators, can effectively reduce the appearance of wrinkles and fine lines by relaxing the underlying muscles.

Personalized Care at AestheticEye

At AestheticEye, we prioritize personalized care and attention to detail. Our expert surgeons, Dr. Henson and Dr. Pargament, will work with you to develop a customized treatment plan that addresses your unique concerns and aesthetic goals.

Initial Consultation and Assessment

Your journey begins with a comprehensive consultation, where we will assess your skin condition, discuss your goals, and recommend the most appropriate non-surgical treatments.

Tailored Treatment Plan

Based on the consultation, we will create a tailored treatment plan designed to achieve natural-looking, long-lasting results. Our goal is to enhance your natural beauty while ensuring your comfort and satisfaction.

Follow-Up and Maintenance

We provide detailed post-treatment care instructions and schedule follow-up appointments to monitor your progress and make any necessary adjustments. Regular maintenance treatments may be recommended to preserve and enhance your results.
